{{Quote|We have reason to believe that Imperial General Otto, stationed at the Imperial base on Lok, may be supplying the explosives being used on the corvette. General Otto is known to be fairly careless, so it would not be surprising if the information you seek was in an unsecured crate or desk somewhere. Seek out his base and return with any information you find.|[[Master Sergeant/Legends|Master Sergeant]] [[Crowley (Twi'lek)|Crowley]], to a Rebel operative|<ref name="SWG:MSC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Master Sergeant Crowley"}}</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Outpost''' on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] was a massive stronghold established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as part of their plan to extend their control over less developed worlds.<ref name="SWG:IO" />

==History==
{{Quote|Go disrupt the Imperial base here on Lok. It's commanded by a man named General Otto. I don't think much of him personally. Show him that being on Lok is not an easy assignment.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to a Rebel operative|<ref name="SWG:TIBoL">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|The Imperial Base on Lok|Lok}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], this outpost was commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Otto]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|65|Who's Who in Star Wars Galaxies|Who's Who in ''Star Wars'' Galaxies}}</ref> At some point, a [[Unidentified mercenary warlord|mercenary warlord]] led a brutal assault on the outpost. General Otto managed to pushed back the attack and the warlord was captured, ending up in the [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|Imperial Prison]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:MB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Mozo Bondog|Dathomir}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Empire managed to capture a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]] and planed to use fill it with explosives and send it hurtling into [[Centerpoint Station]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. The objective was to have the Rebel Alliance blamed for the attack. As the Rebels suspected General Otto might be supplying the explosives being used on the corvette, [[Master Sergeant/Legends|Master Sergeant]] [[Crowley (Twi'lek)|Crowley]] therefore sent an agent to the Imperial outpost on Lok. The Rebel operative successfully retrieved data including the location of the stolen corvette.<ref name="SWG:MSC" />

Around the same time, the retired [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Naval]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Boyrake]] was present in the outpost.<ref name="SWG:AC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|A commoner|Lok}}</ref> Meanwhile, a spacer managed to infiltrate the base and stole a piece of [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="SWG:LISTA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Lost Imperial Shock Trooper Armor}}</ref>

The same year, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] tasked Rebel operatives to disrupt the Imperial outpost to show to the Empire that being on Lok is not an easy assignment. The Rebels infiltrated the base where they shut down the power generators and switched some Imperial banners for Rebel banners. They also attacked General Otto who barely survived the raid.<ref name="SWG:TIBoL" />
